reason: I only have Saturdays with my kid and the zoo is free, so paying $16 plus whatever the kid wants to eat just to sit in a pretty room feels like a lot for Salisbury. I might use the free first visit out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay after.
objection: $16 every Saturday adds up fast when the zoo and the park cost nothing, and it looks more Instagram than actually useful.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $8 to $10, or a free-entry weekend deal that makes it comparable to the zoo.
